title: Welcome to Lampy Paperwork V20
paragraphs: Lampy Paperwork is a browser-based workspace for building fixture patches, power calculations, Fan Out sheets, distro labels, and control/network paperwork for live entertainment.

V20 adds the IP Addresses tab. It compiles consoles and NPUs from Control/Network and supports additional project network devices, with two IP fields, subnet data, VLAN assignments, locations, and notes.

The current app includes GDTF fixture information, MVR import and export, DMX universe viewers, position-linked patch data, phase-total summaries, RCBO warnings, Aux and 3ø output calculations, Fan Out sheets, and revision tracking.

Fixture patches can be imported from CSV, Excel, XLSM, or MVR files and exported as PDF, Excel, or MVR. When an exact library match is available, the exported MVR includes the matched GDTF file and mode.
All project, GDTF, and MVR processing stays within your browser. Download your Lampy project file regularly so that you can reopen and continue your work later.
Use the Walk-through in the Actions menu for the recommended workflow and an overview of the current tools.
Lampy Paperwork remains under active development and testing. Please report bugs, request missing fixtures, or suggest improvements through the GitHub issue tracker:
Thank you for testing Lampy Paperwork.
